* Project Alpha :ctx:
This is the main root context for Project Alpha.
We are building a distributed system with an Emacs client.

** Architecture Overview :ctx:
:PROPERTIES:
:CUSTOM_ID: arch-overview
:STATUS: in-progress
:END:
The architecture consists of a Go engine and an Emacs Lisp interface.
Communication happens via standard I/O (stdin/stdout) using NDJSON events.

*** Networking Layer
Handles HTTP SSE connections to OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
Guards against unencrypted HTTP on non-loopback hosts.
